verdict.rationale: Floot's first-party docs list scheduled jobs as a built-in platform capability: jobs that run on a schedule without a server to keep alive. That covers the core of scheduling recurring jobs within a Floot app, but the evidence is a single one-line mention with no detail. missing for 10: documentation of how schedules are defined (cron syntax, intervals), whether the AI assistant or MCP tools can create and manage schedules, job logs and monitoring, failure and retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
